physical_subject: Why do these tile paths never end inside the pattern?
relationship: A midpoint pairing gives degree two at every interior join; finite components are loops or boundary-to-boundary paths.
operation: Follow an actual connected path, lift and turn its local tile, enlarge a seam, then distinguish a loop from an outer-edge route.
substantive_difference: Local degree-two connectivity of disjoint quarter arcs, not aperiodicity, beat bands or Euler route existence.
